paper_id: Chen et al. - 2019 - The Cask Effect of Multi-source Content Delivery Measurement and Mitigation
title: The Cask Effect of Multi-source Content Delivery: Measurement and Mitigation
motivation: 多源下载加速在23%情况下反而降低速度,违背直觉
problem_framing: 将木桶效应形式化为宏观类型异质性+微观参与时间多样性
key_insight: 加速效果不取决于最快源,而受制于贡献最短的源和参与时间差异
method_signature: 基于ε-greedy的特征贪婪选择+DPT驱动 shuffle
evaluation_criteria: 下载速度增长率(AR)和加速成功率(ASR)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 37%的下载几乎无加速(增长0 KBps),多源策略有时反而降低成功率至50%以下
evidence_for_taste: 23% of downloads have worse performance after being upgraded
a decline in terms of delivery speed often occurs
approximately 37% of downloads are trivially accelerated
multi-source content delivery sometimes generates a worse download speed
thinking_moves: 从宏观类型异质性+微观时序多样性双层解构木桶短板
用工程异常反推理论:多源加速竟有23%恶化
将多臂老虎机问题简化到特征层面而非个体层面
把DPT定义为准静态指标用于实时决策阈值
